Rani Lakshmibai of Jhansi

Rani Lakshmibai of Jhansi was the first Indian ruler to make gunpowder (explosives).
Gunpowder (explosive) was manufactured in China in the 12th century. Then, after about 200 years, this science reached Arab countries and European countries; But the Indian rulers were completely ignorant about this matter. This. In 1526, Babar attacked India with the help of guns and overthrew it. The Queen of Jhansi had an important contribution in the gunpowder war. She was the first Indian ruler who attempted to manufacture gunpowder in India; But due to his period being very short, he did not have much impact.

‘In a letter sent to King Mardan Singh Judev of Banapur, Rani Lakshmi Bai says, ‘Videsi ki ghulami mein rahibo achho nahi hai, unse ladko achho hai’, (It is not good to live in the slavery of foreigners, but it is good to fight them!) This makes her thoughts understandable.

Rani Lakshmi Bai, who respected Brahmins despite being a queen
After being defeated in Kunch, while going towards Kalpi, Godse Bhatji (Panditji) and Rani Lakshmibai suddenly met near a well on the way. He drew water from the well and gave it to her, then the queen rejected it and said, “You are a scholar, you are a scholar, I will not drink the water you have drawn.” I will take it out myself.”

He said that 'I had a property, it was enough for my living and then a widow like me did not even need property. But due to pride in Hindu religion she got influenced. But God did not give success.

Taking weapons and horse riding training in childhood
‘Moropant Tambe’s daughter was familiar with the names ‘Chhabeli’ or ‘Manu’. Along with reading and writing, he also took training in weapons and horse riding. Raja of Jhansi Shri. She was married to Gangadharrao Newalkar. His adopted son's name was Damodar. Gangadhar Rao died after the completion of the son's adoption process.

To prove to fight Queen Hugh Rose
Dalhousie founded the Khalsa Institute. By observing the cleverness of the queen's correspondence at that time, it is possible to estimate her intelligence. Another spark was added to the smoldering conflict in North India. Rani had contacts with Nanasaheb (Peshwa) and Tatya Tope. As soon as Jhansi was attacked by Hugh Rose, the queen proved herself willing to fight with the common citizens, saying 'I will not give up my Jhansi'. A fierce fight took place.

Rani set out towards Kalpi and attacked Gwalior again.
As soon as Jhansi was defeated, she cleverly escaped with her adopted son and reached Kalpi, 107 miles away. Met Tatya there. Kalpi was defeated after three days of fighting. The entire Bundelkhand came under British rule. Tatya and Rani set out towards Gwalior. Hugh Rose and Brigadier Smith attacked Gwalior. He had a fight with the queen at Kotaki Sarai. Before this the queen came to the refuge, hence her father was made prisoner. Next he was hanged.

The queen who displayed incomparable bravery surrendered by saying 'Om Namo Bhagwate Vasudevay'
The queen was surrounded while fighting. The bayonet of a soldier's gun entered his side, blood started gushing out. He killed the one who inflicted the wound. As soon as their maid was shot, they cut the one who fired the bullet into two pieces. Meanwhile, the bullet entered his left thigh. They also killed the person who fired the shot. Then he was hit on the head from behind. Due to this his right eye started hanging. Even in this situation, he cut the shoulder of the attacker. After this the remaining soldiers ran away. The blood soaked queen was brought to the hut of Baba Gangadas. There Gangodak was poured into his mouth. Saying ‘Om Namo Bhagwate Vasudevay’ the queen sacrificed her life.

In memory of this bravery, Netaji Subhash Chandra Boseji created a plaque named 'Rani Laxmibai' for women in Azad Hind Sena.

Rani Laxmibai glorified by poets
Rani Laxmibai of Jhansi: 'Kavivarya Bha on the platform present at the place of death of the queen who was only twenty-eight years old. Ra. There are some lines of Tambe's poem, whose meaning is as follows.

Meaning: O Hindu brothers, stay at this place for a few moments. Shed two tears. Here the same light of bravery whose name was Jhansiwali has gone down.

Queen's pride - She fought very bravely, she was the queen of Jhansi Kali.

In this way, Subhadrakumari Chauhan wrote this glorious Jhansi poem in Hindi. At the end of this poem she writes,

Showed the path, taught us,

The lesson that had to be taught.

The faces of Bundel Harbols,

We heard the story.

fought hard manfully,

She was the queen of Jhansi.

– Dr. Sachchidanand Shevde (Srigjanan Ashish, January 2011)
stories.content_hinglish:
Rani Lakshmibai of Zhansi

barud (visphotak) bananevali pehli bhartiya sattadhish (shasak) jhansi ki rani lakshmibai !
barud (visphotak) ki nirmithi china mein 12vin shatabdi mein hui . taduparant lagbhag 200 varshon ke paschat yah vigyan arab deshon tatha european deshon mein pahuncha; kintu bhartiya sattadhish is vishay mein purnatah anbhigya the . e.s. 1526men babar ne bharatpar bandukon ke balpar aakraman kar use padakrant kiya . barood ke yudh mein jhansi ki rani ka mahatvapurn yogdaan tha . ve pehli bhartiya shasak thin, jinhone bharat mein barood banane ke liye pehli baar bharat mein prayatn kiya; kintu unka kaalkhand atyant chhota hone ke karan uska adhik prabhav nahin pada .

‘banapur ke raja mardan singh judev ko bheje patra mein rani lakshmibai kehti han, ‘videshiyon ki gulami mein rahibo accho nahin hai, unse ladko accho hai’, (videshiyon ki dasyata mein rehna acha nahin hai, apitu unse ladna acha hai !) isse unke vichar samajh mein aate hain .

rani hote hue bhi brahman ka aadar karnewali rani lakshmibai
kunch mein parast honepar kalpiki or jaate samay marg mein ek kuen ke paas achanak godse bhatji (panditji ) aur rani lakshmibai ki bhet hui . unhone kuen se pani nikalkar diya, tab use nakarkar rani ne kaha, ‘‘aap pandit han, vidwan han, aapke dwara nikalkar diya pani main nahin piungi . main hi nikalti hun .’’

unka kehna tha ki ‘mere paas jagir thi, wah mere jeevanyapan ke liye bahut thi aur phir mujh samaan vidhwa ko sampatti ki aavashyakta bhi nahin thi . parantu hindu dharm ke abhimanvash pravritt hui dhi . parantu ishwar ne safalta nahin di .’

bachapan mein shastra aur ghudaswari ka prashikshan lena
‘moropant tambe ki kanya ‘chhabeli’ athva ‘manu’ in naamon se parichit thi . likhne-padhne ke saath unhone shastra aur ghudaswari ka bhi prashikshan liya . jhansi ke raja shri. gangadharrao nevaalakar ke saath unka vivah hua . unke dattakputra ka naam damodar tha . putra ki dattak vidhi sampann hone ke uprant gangadharrao ka nidhan ho gaya tha .

rani hue roj se ladne ke liye siddh hona
dalhausi ne sansthan khalsa kiya . us samay rani ki patravyavhar ke vishay mein chaturta dekhnepar, unki budhimanta ka anumaan karna sambhav hota hai . uttar hindusthan ke sulagte sangharsh mein aur ek chingari padi . rani ka nanasaheb (peshva) aur tatya tope ke saath sampark tha . hue roj dwara jhansipar aakraman hote hi ‘meri jhansi nahin dungi’, aisa kahte hue rani sarvsadharan nagrikon ke saath ladne ke liye siddh hui . ghamasan ladai hui .

kalpiki or nikal padi ranipar pun: gwalior mein aakraman hona
jhansi parast hote hi, wah dattakputra ke saath badi chaturta se nikalkar 107 meal door kalpi pahunchi . vahanpar tatya se bhet hui . teen dinki ladai ke uprant kalpi ka paraabhav hua . sampurna bundelkhandper angrejon ka rajya aa gaya . tatya aur rani gwalior ki or nikal pade . gwaliyarpar hue roj aur brigadier smith ne aakraman kiya . kotaki sarai mein rani ke saath unki ladai hui . iske purva rani sharan mein aaye, isliye uske pitaji ko bandi banaya gaya . aage unhen fansi di gai .

atulniy parakram dikhanewali ranidwara ‘om namo bhagwate vasudevay’ kahte hue pranarpan karna
ladai karte samay rani ko gher liya gaya . ek sainik ki bandook ka bionet unki karvat mein ghus gaya, rakt ufankar bahane laga . ghavalganewale ko unhone maar dala . unki dasi ko goli lagte hi, unhone goli chalanewale ke do tukde kar diye . itne mein unki bai jaangh mein goli ghus gai . goli chalanewale ko bhi unhone maut ke ghat utaar diya . tabhi peeche se unke sirpar prahar kiya gaya . isse unki daeen aankh latakne lagi . is avastha mein bhi prahar karnewale ka kandha unhone kaat dala . iske paschat bache hue sainik bhag gaye . rakt se lathpath rani ko baba gangadas ki kutiya mein laya gaya . vahanpar uske mukh mein gangodak dala gaya . ‘om namo bhagwate vasudevay’ kahte hue rani ne apne pran tyaag diye .

is parakram ki smriti mein netaji subhashchandra bosji ne azad hind sena mein striyon ka ‘rani lakshmibai’ naam ka pathak nirman kiya .

kaviyondwara gaurvanvit rani lakshmibai
jhansi ki rani lakshmibai : ‘keval atthais varsh ki aayu prapt rani ke mrityusthanpar vidyamaan chabutarepar kavivarya bha. ra. tambe ki kavita ki kuch panktiyan han, jinka bhavarth is prakar hai .

arth : he hindu bandhu, kuch kshanon ke liye is sthanpar thahar jao . do ashru bahao . yahanpar usi parakram ki jyoti ka ast hua hai, jiska naam jhansiwali tha .

rani ka gaurav- khoob ladi mardani, kah to jhansikali rani thi .

is prakar se hindi mein subhadrakumari chauhan ne gauravshali jhansi yah kavita likhi . is kavita ke ant mein ve likhti han,

dikha gai path, sikha gai hamko,

jo seekh sikhani thi .

bundel harbolon ke mukh,

hamane suni kahani thi .

khub ladi mardani,

vah to jhansikali rani thi ॥

– do. sachchidanand shewde (shrigajanan aasish, january 2011)

stories.content:
केवल १६ वर्ष की आयु में ही छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज ने स्वराज स्थापित करने की प्रतिज्ञा की । गिने-चुने मावलों में धर्मप्रेम की जागृति कर उन्हें लडना सिखाया और स्वराज की संकल्पना से उन्हें अवगत कराया । हिंदू स्वराज्य के लिए गिने-चुने मावलों ने प्राणों की चिंता किए बिना अपने-आप को झोंक दिया । पांच मुसलमानी सुल्तनतों के विरोध में लडते-लडते एक एक भूप्रदेश को जीत लिया ।

केवल ५० वर्ष की आयु में विजापूर और देहली की राजसत्ताओं को निरस्त किया । वर्ष १६७४ में उनके गुरु समर्थ रामदास स्वामी के मार्गदर्शन के अनुसार हिंदू स्वराज स्थापित करने की घोषणा की । अपने-आपको राज्याभिषेक करवाकर हिंदू धर्म को राजसिंहासन दिलवाया ।

छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज को स्वराज की जनता अब अपने भाग्यविधाता के रूप में देखने लगी । कुछ लोग तो उन्हें हिंदुपतपातशाह कहने लगे । छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज ने वेदों की पुराणों की, मंदिरों की रक्षा की और मुख में रामनाम अबाधित रखा । अपने मित्रोंसहित हिंदू स्वराज की शपथ ली ।

हिंदू स्वराज की साक्ष्य
रायरेश्वरसह्याद्रीच्या कडेकपारी, शिवमंदिर एक ।

तिथे रायरेश्वर स्वयंभू शिवलिंग सुरेख ॥

आणाभाका झाल्या आमुच्या, त्याच्या साक्षीने ।

एकजुटीने राहून कोणा अंतर न देणे ॥

देशासाठी, धर्मासाठी झोकून देऊ उडी ।

मावळे आम्ही शिवबाचे सवंगडी ॥

(अर्थ : सह्याद्रि पर्वत के एक शिखरपर स्थित रायरेश्‍वर का स्वयंभू शिवलिंग है । उन्हीं के समक्ष हमने शपथ ग्रहण की । हम मिल-जुलकर रहेंगे । किसी को हमसे दूर नहीं होने देंगे । देश और धर्म के लिए स्वयं को झोक देंगे । हम मावले छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज के मित्र हैं ।)

प्रकृति के अनेकविध रुपों का दर्शन करानेवाला रमणीय रायरेश्‍वर गढ (किला) पुणे जिले के तहसील भोर में बसा है । वह समुद्र की सतह से ४६९४ फूट उंचाईपर बसा है । यहां से कैराटागढ, केंजलगढ, पांडकगढ, कमलगढ, पाचगणी, महाबलेश्‍वर, कोलेश्‍वर, रायगढ, लिंगाणा, तिकोणा, राजगढ, तोरणा, सिंहगढ, पुरंदर, कङ्कागढ, प्रतापगढ, चंद्रगढ आदि गढकिले दिखाई देते हैं ।

रायरेश्‍वर गढ के पहाडी मैदान की लंबाई ११.०४ कि.मी है । चौडाई १.०२कि.मी है । जहां छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज ने शपथ ली थी वह शिवमंदिर और माता जननी का मंदिर गडपर है । छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज ने शिवा जंगम नामक पुजारी को वहां नियुक्त किया था । वर्तमान में वहां जंगम लोगों के ४०परिवार रहते हैं ।

तहसील भोर के सह्याद्री पर्वत के एक शिखरपर विराजित रायरेश्‍वर के स्वयंभू शिवालय में छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज ने २६ अप्रैल १६४५ में हिंदू स्वराज स्थापित करने की शपथ ली थी । बारह मावल प्रांतो से कान्होजी जेधे, बाजी पासलकर, तानाजी मालुसरे, सूर्याजी मालुसरे, येसाजी कंक, सूर्याजी काकडे, बापूजी मुदगल, नरसप्रभू गुप्ते, सोनोपंत डबीर जैसे लोग भोर के पहाडों से परिचित थे । इन सिंहसमान महापराक्रमी मावलों को साथ लेकर शिवाजी महाराज ने स्वयंभू रायरेश्‍वर के समक्ष स्वराज की प्रतिज्ञा ली ।

रायरेश्‍वर गडकी अधिक जानकारी के लिए यहां क्लिक करें !
stories.title: छत्रपति शिवाजी महाराज और रायरेश्वर गढ
stories.title_english: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj and Raireshwar Garh
stories.title_hinglish: chhatrapati shivaji maharaj aur raireshwar gadh
stories.content_english:
At the age of only 16, Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj pledged to establish Swaraj. In a few selected cases, he awakened the love of religion, taught them to fight and made them aware of the concept of Swaraj. A few Mavalas sacrificed themselves for Hindu Swaraj without worrying about their lives. While fighting against five Muslim Sultans, they conquered each and every territory.

At the age of just 50, he abolished the kingdoms of Vijapur and Delhi. In the year 1674, according to the guidance of his guru Samarth Ramdas Swami, he announced the establishment of Hindu Swaraj. By getting himself coronated, he got the throne of Hindu religion.

The people of Swaraj now started seeing Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj as the creator of their destiny. Some people started calling him Hindupatpatshah. Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj protected the Vedas, Puranas, temples and kept the name of Ram in his mouth uninterrupted. Took oath of Hindu Swaraj along with his friends.

Evidence of Hindu Swaraj
Raireshwarsahyadrichya kadekpari, shivmandir one.

There Rayareshwar Swayambhu Shivalinga is beautiful.

Aambhaaka became Aamuchya, his witness.

Stay united and don't make any difference.

I will sacrifice myself for the country and religion.

Maavle Aami Shivbache Savangdi ॥

(Meaning: There is a self-proclaimed Shivalinga of Rayareshwar situated on a peak of the Sahyadri Mountains. We took an oath before him. We will live together. We will not let anyone go away from us. We will sacrifice ourselves for the country and religion. We are friends of Mavle Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj.)

The delightful Raireshwar Garh (Fort), which gives a glimpse of the diverse forms of nature, is situated in Tehsil Bhor of Pune district. It is situated at a height of 4694 feet above sea level. From here the forts like Kairatagarh, Kenjalgarh, Pandakgarh, Kamalgarh, Pachgani, Mahabaleshwar, Koleshwar, Raigarh, Lingana, Tikona, Rajgarh, Torna, Singhgarh, Purandar, Kankagarh, Pratapgarh, Chandragarh etc. are visible.

The length of the hill plain of Raireshwar Garh is 11.04 km. The width is 1.02 km. The place where Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj took oath is Shiv Mandir and Mata Janani Temple at Gadpar. Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj had appointed a priest named Shiva Jangam there. Presently 40 families of Jangam people live there.

Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj took the oath to establish Hindu Swaraj on 26 April 1645 in the self-styled Shivaji temple of Rayareshwar situated on a peak of the Sahyadri Mountains in Tehsil Bhor. People like Kanhoji Jedhe, Baji Pasalkar, Tanaji Malusare, Suryaji Malusare, Yesaji Kank, Suryaji Kakade, Bapuji Mudgal, Narasprabhu Gupte, Sonopant Dabir from the twelve Maval provinces were familiar with the mountains of dawn. Taking these lion-like and mighty warriors along with him, Shivaji Maharaj took the pledge of Swaraj in front of the self-proclaimed Rayareshwar.

stories.content_hinglish:
keval 16 varsh ki aayu mein hi chhatrapati shivaji maharaj ne swaraj sthapit karne ki pratigya ki . gine-chune mavalon mein dharmprem ki jagriti kar unhen ladna sikhaya aur swaraj ki sankalpana se unhen avgat karaya . hindu swarajya ke liye gine-chune mavalon ne pranon ki chinta kiye bina apne-aap ko jhonk diya . paanch musalmani sultanaton ke virodh mein ladte-ladte ek ek bhupradesh ko jeet liya .

keval 50 varsh ki aayu mein vijapur aur dehli ki rajsattaon ko nirast kiya . varsh 1674 mein unke guru samarth ramdas swami ke margdarshan ke anusar hindu swaraj sthapit karne ki ghoshana ki . apne-aapko rajyabhishek karwakar hindu dharm ko rajsinhasan dilwaya .

chhatrapati shivaji maharaj ko swaraj ki janta ab apne bhagyavidhata ke roop mein dekhne lagi . kuch log to unhen hindupatpatshah kahne lage . chhatrapati shivaji maharaj ne vedon ki puranon ki, mandiron ki raksha ki aur mukh mein ramnam abadhit rakha . apne mitronsahit hindu swaraj ki shapath lee .

hindu swaraj ki sakshya
raireshwarsahyadrichya kadekpari, shivmandir ek .

tithe raireshwar swayambhu shivling surekh ॥

aanabhaka jhalya aamuchya, tyachya sakshine .

ekjutine rahoon kona antar na dene ॥

deshasathi, dharmasathi jhokun deu udi .

mavale aamhi shivbache sawangdi ॥

(arth : sahyadri parvat ke ek shikharpar sthit rairesh‍var ka swayambhu shivling hai . unhin ke samaksh humne shapath grahan ki . hum mil-julkar rahenge . kisi ko humse door nahin hone denge . desh aur dharm ke liye swayam ko jhok denge . hum mavale chhatrapati shivaji maharaj ke mitra hain .)

prakriti ke anekavidh rupon ka darshan karanevala ramniya rairesh‍var gadh (kila) pune jile ke tehsil bhor mein basa hai . wah samudra ki satah se 4694 foot uncyper basa hai . yahan se caratagarh, kenjalagarh, pandakgarh, kamlagarh, pachagani, mahablesh‍var, kolesh‍var, raigarh, lingana, tikona, rajgarh, torana, singhgarh, purander, kadkagarh, pratapagarh, chandragarh aadi gadhkile dikhai dete hain .

rairesh‍var gadh ke pahadi maidan ki lambai 11.04 ki.mi hai . chaudai 1.02ki.mi hai . jahan chhatrapati shivaji maharaj ne shapath lee thi wah shivmandir aur mata janani ka mandir gadper hai . chhatrapati shivaji maharaj ne shiva jangam naamak pujari ko vahan niyukt kiya tha . vartmaan mein vahan jangam logon ke 40parivar rahte hain .

tahsil bhor ke sahyadri parvat ke ek shikharpar virajit rairesh‍var ke swayambhu shivalay mein chhatrapati shivaji maharaj ne 26 april 1645 mein hindu swaraj sthapit karne ki shapath lee thi . barah maval pranto se kanhoji jedhe, baji pasalkar, tanaji malusre, suryaji malusre, yesaji kank, suryaji kakade, bapuji mudgal, narsaprabhu gupte, sonopant dabir jaise log bhor ke pahadon se parichit the . in singhsaman mahaparakrami mavalon ko saath lekar shivaji maharaj ne swayambhu rairesh‍var ke samaksh swaraj ki pratigya lee .

stories.content: आबाजी सोनदेव ने आगे बढकर शिवाजी महाराज को अभिवादन किया और सील-बंद कोशका संदूक प्रस्तुत करते हुए कहा, ‘‘आपके आशीर्वाद से हमने बीजापुर का यह कोश अपने अधिकार में ले लिया है । कोश के साथ उनके सब सैनिक, सरदार सूबेदार, मुल्ला एवं मूहम्मद को बंदी बना लिया हैं । महाराज ! इस आक्रमण के समय एक बहुमूल्य वस्तू भी हमें मिली ।’’ इतना कहकर आबाजी सैनिकों के पीछेसे बुरकापोश सुंदरी को आगे ले आए और झुककर बोले ,‘‘महाराज, यह है वह बेशकीम…’’ उसका वाक्य तो रहा ही किंतु उनके शब्द भी पूरे न हो सके । शिवाजी महाराज क्रोध में आपे से बाहर हो गए और गरज उठे, ‘‘खामोश! बेशर्म आबाजी, खामोश ! यह सब करने से पहले आपके हाथ टूट क्यों नहीं गए, यह कहने से पहले जीभ कटकर गिर क्यों नहीं गई । आखिर हम ने स्वराज्य की स्थापना का व्रत ही क्यों लिया है ? क्या दूसरों की बहू-बेटियों की अस्मत लूटने के लिए ? दूसरों के धर्मस्थान नष्ट करने के लिए ? कभी नहीं । हम हिंदु हैं । सबसे बडे शत्रु की बहू-बेटी भी हमारी मां-बेटी है, धर्मपुत्री है ।’’ महिला ने बुर्का मुंह से हटा दिया । शिवाजी महाराज ने महिला से कहा, ‘‘बहन! हम आपको किस मुंह से क्षमा मांगे । आप बंदी नहीं, हमारी प्रतिष्ठित अतिथि हैं । आप अपने सैनिकों के साथ जाने के लिए स्वतंत्र हैं ।’’‘‘ किन लफ्जों में आपका शुक्रिया अदा करूं, ऐ मेरे रहनुमा ! माफी मागंकर मुझे गैरत में न डालिए । आप जैसे फरिश्तों की कामयाबी में ही कौम और मुल्क की इज्जत छिपी है,’’ कहते हुए उस सुंदरी ने झुककर सलाम किया और पुन: बुर्का मुंहपर ओढ लिया ।

stories.title_english: Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj, founder of Swarajya
stories.title_hinglish: swarajya ke sansthapak chhatrapati shivaji maharaj
stories.content_english: Aabaji Sondev stepped forward and greeted Shivaji Maharaj and presented the sealed box of the dictionary saying, “With your blessings we have taken possession of this dictionary of Bijapur. Along with Kosh, all his soldiers, Sardar Subedar, Mullah and Muhammad have been taken prisoner. Maharaj ! During this attack, we also found a valuable object.'' Saying this, Aabaji brought the burqa-clad beauty forward from behind the soldiers and bowed down and said, "Maharaja, this is a priceless thing..." His sentence remained complete but his words could not be completed. Shivaji Maharaj lost his temper in anger and roared, “Silence! Shameless Aabaji, keep quiet! Why didn't your hands get broken before doing all this, why didn't your tongue get cut and fall off before saying this. After all, why have we taken a vow to establish Swarajya? Is it to rob the dignity of others' daughters-in-law? To destroy the religious places of others? Never . We are Hindus. The daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law of our biggest enemy are also our mother and daughter, our daughters.'' The woman removed the burqa from her mouth. Shivaji Maharaj said to the woman, “Sister! How can we ask you for forgiveness? You are not a prisoner, you are our honored guest. You are free to go with your soldiers.'' ''In what words can I thank you, O my leader! Don't embarrass me by apologizing. The honor of the community and the country is hidden only in the success of angels like you,” saying this the beautiful woman bowed and saluted and again covered her face with the burqa.
stories.content_hinglish: abaji sondev ne aage badhakar shivaji maharaj ko abhivadan kiya aur sil-band koshaka sandook prastut karte hue kaha, ‘‘aapke ashirwad se humne bijapur ka yah kosh apne adhikar mein le liya hai . kosh ke saath unke sab sainik, sardar subedar, mulla evam muhammad ko bandi bana liya hain . maharaj ! is aakraman ke samay ek bahumulya vastu bhi hamen mili .’’ itna kahkar abaji sainikon ke pichhese burkaposh sundari ko aage le aaye aur jhukakar bole ,‘‘maharaj, yah hai wah beshakim…’’ uska vakya to raha hi kintu unke shabd bhi poore na ho sake . shivaji maharaj krodh mein aape se bahar ho gaye aur garaj uthe, ‘‘khamosh! besharm aabaji, khamosh ! yah sab karne se pehle aapke haath toot kyon nahin gaye, yah kahne se pehle jeebh katkar gir kyon nahin gai . aakhir hum ne swarajya ki sthapna ka vrat hi kyon liya hai ? kya dusron ki bahu-betiyon ki asmat lootne ke liye ? dusron ke dharmsthan nasht karne ke liye ? kabhi nahin . hum hindu hain . sabse bade shatru ki bahu-beti bhi hamari man-beti hai, dharmputri hai .’’ mahila ne burqa munh se hata diya . shivaji maharaj ne mahila se kaha, ‘‘bahan! hum aapko kis munh se kshama maange . aap bandi nahin, hamari pratishthit atithi hain . aap apne sainikon ke saath jaane ke liye swatantra hain .’’‘‘ kin lafzon mein aapka shukriya ada karun, ae mere rahnuma ! maafi maagankar mujhe gairat mein na daliye . aap jaise farishton ki kamyabi mein hi kaum aur mulk ki ijjat chipi hai,’’ kahte hue us sundari ne jhukakar salaam kiya aur pun: burqa munhpar odh liya .

stories.content:
बालमित्रों, भारत के इतिहास में राजा महाराणा प्रताप का नाम अमर है । महाराणा प्रताप राजस्थान के शूरवीर एवं स्वाभिमानी राजा थे । जयपुर के राणा मानसिंह ने अकबरद्वारा अपने राज्य को कष्ट न हो; इसलिए अपनी बहन का विवाह अकबर से किया । एक बार अपने वैभव के प्रदर्शन हेतु राजपूत देहली जाते समय मार्ग में स्थित महाराणा प्रताप से मिलने कुंभलगढ गए । महाराणा प्रताप ने उन सभी का योग्य आदर सत्कार किया; परंतु उसने साथ बैठकर भोजन न करने की इच्छा व्यक्त की । मानसिंहद्वारा कारण पूछनेपर महाराणा प्रताप ने कहा, ‘‘समशेरी (मुगल शासक)से अपने राज्य की रक्षा करने की अपेक्षा अपनी बेटी-बहनों को मुगलों के हाथ देकर उनसे राज्य की रक्षा करानेवाले स्वाभिमान शून्य राजपूतों के साथ बैठकर मैं भोजन नहीं करता ।’’

महाराणा प्रतापजीद्वारा कहे गए कटु सत्य सुनकर मानसिंह भोजन की थाली छोड, खडा हुआ और क्रोधित होकर चिल्लाया, ‘‘महाराणा प्रताप ! रणक्षेत्र में तेरा सत्यानाश नहीं किया, तो मेरा नाम मानसिंह नहीं !’’

कुछ समय उपरांत मानसिंह, अकबर के पुत्र सलीम एवं प्रचंड सैन्य के साथ महाराणा प्रताप से युद्ध करने निकला । यह सूचना मिलते ही महाराणा प्रताप ने तत्परता से अरावली पर्वत से आने वाले मार्ग पर मानसिंह की सेना पर आक्रमण आरंभ किया और उनकी अधिकांश सेना को मिट्टी में मिला दिया । महाराणा प्रतापजी की तलवार से सलीम का वध होने वाला था; परंतु वह वार उसके हाथीपर हुआ और सलीम बच गया । महाराणा प्रताप की तलवार के भय से मानसिंह सेना के पीछे था । महाराणा अपनी धारदार चमकती तलवार से शत्रु के घेरे से बाहर निकलने का प्रयास कर रहे थे । इतने में किसी शत्रु सैनिक ने महाराणाजी के घोडे ‘चेतक’के एक पैर में तीर मारकर उसे घायल कर दिया । ऐसी स्थिति में भी वह स्वामीनिष्ठ घोडा अपनी पीठ पर बैठे महाराणाजी को बचाने के लिए भागकर उस घेरे को भेदने का प्रयास करने लगा । इतने में मार्ग में नाला आया । चेतक ने छलांग लगाकर वह नाला पार किया, परंतु हृदय गति रुकने के कारण उसने अपने प्राण त्याग दिए ।

महाराणा प्रतापजी ने पीछे मुडकर देखा, तो अकबर की सेना में भर्ती हुआ उनका छोटा भाई शक्तिसिंह, चार-पांच मुगल सैनिकों को जान से मार रहा था । वह दृश्य देखकर महाराणाजी आश्चर्यचकित हुए । इतने में उन पांच सैनिकों के प्राण लेकर शक्तिसिंह महाराणा के पास आया एवं उन्हें आलिंगन में लेकर कहने लगा, ‘‘भैया ! मैं मुगलों की सेना में हूं, तो भी आपका असीम शौर्य, पराक्रम के कारण आप ही मेरा आदर्श हैं । मैं आपके इस स्वामीनिष्ठ घोडे से भी तुच्छ हूं ।’’

मेवाड का इतिहास लिखनेवाले कर्नल टॉण्ड ने महाराणा प्रतापजी का गौरव बताते हुए कहा है, ‘उत्कट महत्वाकांक्षी, शासन निपुणता एवं अपरिमित साधन संपत्ति के बलपर अकबर ने दृढनिश्चयी, धैर्यशाली, उज्ज्वल कीर्तिमान और साहसी महाराणा प्रताप के आत्मबल को गिराने का प्रयास किया; परंतु वह निष्फल हुआ ।’

बालमित्रों, आपको अभी शूरवीर तथा स्वाभिमानी राजा राणा प्रतापजी की कथा ज्ञात हुई । यदि हम सर्व प्राणीमात्र से प्रेम करें, तो पशु भी हमसे प्रेम करने लगते हैं । यह आपको घोडे ‘चेतक’के उदाहरण से ध्यान में आया होगा । उस स्वामिनिष्ठ घोडे ने अपने प्राणों की चिंता किये बिना राजा को बचाया । महाराणा प्रताप के भाई शक्तिसिंह ने भी स्वामीनिष्ठ चेतक को श्रेष्ठ बताया । हमें भी सबसे प्रेम करना सीखना चाहिए । साथ ही अपनी मातृभूमि की रक्षा के लिए सदैव तत्पर रहना चाहिए ।
stories.title: अंतिम क्षण तक साथ देनेवाला महाराणा प्रताप का स्वामीनिष्ठ घोडा चेतक !
stories.title_english: Chetak, the beloved horse of Maharana Pratap, who supported him till the last moment!
stories.title_hinglish: antim kshan tak saath denewala maharana pratap ka swaminishth ghoda chetak !
stories.content_english:
Children's friends, the name of King Maharana Pratap is immortal in the history of India. Maharana Pratap was a brave and proud king of Rajasthan. Rana Mansingh of Jaipur asked Akbar not to let his kingdom suffer; Therefore he married his sister to Akbar. Once, to display his grandeur, Rajput went to Kumbhalgarh to meet Maharana Pratap on his way to Delhi. Maharana Pratap honored all of them with due respect; But he expressed his desire not to sit and eat together. When Mansingh asked the reason, Maharana Pratap said, “I do not eat while sitting with Rajputs who have no self-respect and who give their daughters and sisters to the Mughals and make them protect their kingdom instead of protecting their kingdom from Samsheri (Mughal ruler).”

After hearing the bitter truth told by Maharana Pratapji, Mansingh left the plate of food, stood up and shouted angrily, “Maharana Pratap! If I don't annihilate you in the battlefield, then my name is not Mansingh!'

After some time, Mansingh, along with Akbar's son Salim and his powerful army, went out to fight Maharana Pratap. As soon as Maharana Pratap received this information, he immediately started attacking Mansingh's army on the route coming from Aravali Mountains and destroyed most of his army. Salim was about to be killed by Maharana Pratapji's sword; But that attack was on his elephant and Salim was saved. Mansingh was behind the army due to fear of Maharana Pratap's sword. Maharana was trying to get out of the enemy's circle with his sharp shining sword. Meanwhile, some enemy soldier shot an arrow in the leg of Maharanaji's horse 'Chetak' and injured it. Even in such a situation, that loyal horse ran away to save Maharanaji sitting on its back and tried to break through the circle. Meanwhile a drain came on the way. Chetak jumped and crossed the drain, but due to heart failure he sacrificed his life.

When Maharana Pratapji looked back, his younger brother Shaktisingh, who had joined Akbar's army, was killing four-five Mughal soldiers. Maharanaji was surprised to see that scene. Meanwhile, taking the lives of those five soldiers, Shaktisingh came to Maharana and embraced him and said, “Brother! Even though I am in the Mughal army, you are my ideal because of your immense bravery and bravery. I am even worse than this masterly horse of yours.”

Colonel Tond, who wrote the history of Mewar, while describing the pride of Maharana Pratapji, has said, 'On the strength of his intense ambition, administrative skills and unlimited resources, Akbar tried to break the self-confidence of the determined, patient, bright record and courageous Maharana Pratap; But he failed.

Children's friends, you have just come to know the story of the brave and proud king Rana Pratapji. If we love all living beings, then even animals start loving us. You might have remembered this from the example of the horse 'Chetak'. That obedient horse saved the king without worrying about his life. Maharana Pratap's brother Shaktisingh also described Swaminishtha Chetak as the best. We should also learn to love everyone. At the same time, one should always be ready to protect one's motherland.
stories.content_hinglish:
balmitron, bharat ke itihaas mein raja maharana pratap ka naam amar hai . maharana pratap rajasthan ke shoorveer evam swabhimani raja the . jaipur ke rana mansingh ne akbardwara apne rajya ko kasht na ho; isliye apni bahan ka vivah akbar se kiya . ek baar apne vaibhav ke pradarshan hetu rajput dehli jaate samay marg mein sthit maharana pratap se milne kunbhalgad gaye . maharana pratap ne un sabhi ka yogya aadar satkar kiya; parantu usne saath baithkar bhojan na karne ki ichchha vyakt ki . mansinghdwara karan puchhanepar maharana pratap ne kaha, ‘‘samsheri (mugal shasak)se apne rajya ki raksha karne ki apeksha apni beti-bahnon ko mugalon ke haath dekar unse rajya ki raksha karanewale swabhiman shunya rajputon ke saath baithkar main bhojan nahin karta .’’

maharana pratapajeedwara kahe gaye katu satya sunkar mansingh bhojan ki thali chhod, khada hua aur krodhit hokar chillaya, ‘‘maharana pratap ! ranakshetra mein tera satyanash nahin kiya, to mera naam mansingh nahin !’’

kuchh samay uprant mansingh, akbar ke putra salim evam prachand sainya ke saath maharana pratap se yudh karne nikla . yah suchana milte hi maharana pratap ne tatparta se aravali parvat se aane wale marg par mansingh ki sena par aakraman aarambh kiya aur unki adhikansh sena ko mitti mein mila diya . maharana pratapji ki talwar se salim ka vadh hone wala tha; parantu wah war uske hathipar hua aur salim bach gaya . maharana pratap ki talwar ke bhay se mansingh sena ke peeche tha . maharana apni dhardar chamakti talwar se shatru ke ghere se bahar nikalne ka prayas kar rahe the . itne mein kisi shatru sainik ne maharanaji ke ghode ‘chetak’ke ek pair mein teer markar use ghayal kar diya . aisi sthiti mein bhi wah swaminishth ghoda apni peeth par baithe maharanaji ko bachane ke liye bhaagkar us ghere ko bhedne ka prayas karne laga . itne mein marg mein nala aaya . chetak ne chhalang lagakar wah nala paar kiya, parantu hriday gati rukne ke karan usne apne pran tyaag diye .

maharana pratapji ne peeche mudkar dekha, to akbar ki sena mein bharti hua unka chhota bhai shaktisingh, char-panch mugal sainikon ko jaan se maar raha tha . wah drishya dekhkar maharanaji aashcharyachakit hue . itne mein un paanch sainikon ke pran lekar shaktisingh maharana ke paas aaya evam unhen aalingan mein lekar kahne laga, ‘‘bhaiya ! main mugalon ki sena mein hun, to bhi aapka aseem shaurya, parakram ke karan aap hi mera aadarsh hain . main aapke is swaminishth ghode se bhi tuchchh hun .’’

mewad ka itihaas likhnevale karnal toand ne maharana pratapji ka gaurav batate hue kaha hai, ‘utkat mahatvakankshi, shasan nipunta evam aparimit sadhan sampatti ke balpar akbar ne dridhanishchayi, dhairyashali, ujjwal kirtimaan aur sahasi maharana pratap ke aatmbal ko girane ka prayas kiya; parantu wah nishfal hua .’

balmitron, aapko abhi shoorveer tatha swabhimani raja rana pratapji ki katha gyat hui . yadi hum sarv pranimatra se prem karen, to pashu bhi humse prem karne lagte hain . yah aapko ghode ‘chetak’ke udaharan se dhyan mein aaya hoga . us swaminishth ghode ne apne pranon ki chinta kiye bina raja ko bachaya . maharana pratap ke bhai shaktisingh ne bhi swaminishth chetak ko shreshth bataya . hamen bhi sabse prem karna seekhna chahiye . saath hi apni matrabhoomi ki raksha ke liye sadaiv tatpar rehna chahiye .

stories.content:
बालमित्रों, कर्ण दुर्योधन का घनिष्ठ मित्र था । वह एक महान दानी के रूप में प्रसिद्ध था । वह अपने पास आए किसी भी याचक को कभी खाली हाथ नहीं लौटाता था, ऐसी उसकी कीर्ति थी । वह प्रतिदिन सुबह स्नान के लिए नदीपर जाता था । जल में उतरकर सूर्य को अर्घ देता और स्नान के उपरांत जो भी याचक उसके पास आता, उसे वह मुंहमांगी वस्तु प्रदान करता था ।

एक बार भगवान श्रीकृष्ण तथा अर्जुन बैठे वार्तालाप कर रहे थे । बातों- बातों में कर्ण की दान वीरता का विषय आ गया । श्रीकृष्णजी ने कर्ण की दानवीरता की प्रशंसा की । श्रीकृष्ण बोले, ‘‘कर्ण जितना उदार व्यक्ति अन्य कोई नहीं है ।’’ इसपर अर्जुन को थोडा आश्चर्य हुआ । अर्जुन बोला, ‘‘श्रीकृष्ण, धर्मराज भी दानवीर हैं ।” तब सर्वाधिक दानवीर कौन है ? इसपर उनकी चर्चा आरंभ हो गई । श्रीकृष्ण बोले, ‘‘ठीक है, कल ही हम धर्मराज और कर्ण दोनों के पास जा कर इसकी परीक्षा लेंगे ।”

वर्षा के दिन थे । अगले दिन सूरज निकलते ही श्रीकृष्ण तथा अर्जुन धर्मराज के पास गए । उन्हें देखकर धर्मराज को अत्यंत आनंद हुआ । उन्होंने उन दोनों का यथोचित स्वागत किया और फिर उनके वहां आने का कारण पूछा । तब श्रीकृष्ण बोले, ‘‘राजधानी में अचानक एक महत्त्वपूर्ण निर्माण कार्य करना है । उसके लिए लकडियां चाहिए ।” धर्मराज ने अपने सेवकों को बुलाया तथा निर्माण कार्य के लिए उत्तम प्रकार की लकडियां लाने की आज्ञा दी । इधर-उधर की बातें हुईं । बहुत समय निकल गया, किंतु सेवक वापस नहीं लौटे । कुछ समय के उपरांत सेवक अपना सिर झुकाए लौटे । धर्मराज बोले, ‘‘क्या हुआ ? लकडियां नहीं मिलीं ?” सेवकों ने उत्तर दिया, ‘‘वर्षा के कारण सारी लकडियां भीग चुकी थीं, इस कारण हम लकडियां नहीं ला सके हैं ।’’ हार कर धर्मराज ने अर्जुन तथा श्रीकृष्ण को लकडियां न मिलने का कारण बताया । श्रीकृष्ण तथा अर्जुन लौट गए ।

तदुपरांत वे कर्ण के पास गए । कर्ण ने उन्हें आदरपूर्वक आसन ग्रहण करने को कहा और उनका कुशलक्षेम पूछा । इसपर अर्जुन ने लकडियों की अचानक आवश्यकता आन पडने के बारे में बताया । कर्ण बोला, ‘‘इतना ही न, तो इसमें इतनी चिंता करने की क्या बात है ?” ऐसा कहा कर उसने अपने सेवकों को लकडियां लाने भेजा । कुछ समय में वह सेवक लौट आया और बोला, ‘‘बारिश में लकडियां भीग चुकी हैं । इसलिए नहीं मिलीं ।’’ सेवकों की बात सुनते ही कर्ण अंदर गया और बहुत समय होने के उपरांत भी जब वह बाहर नहीं आया तो अर्जुन श्रीकृष्ण की और देखने लगा । श्रीकृष्ण उसे साथ लेकर कर्ण के दालन में गया । तब देखता क्या है, कर्ण अपने पलंग के पाये काट रहा था और उसने आसपास भी लकडी का अन्य सामान तोडकर रखा है । तब उनके ध्यान मे आया कि कर्ण को इतना समय क्यों लग रहा है । अर्जुन ने पूछा, ‘‘कर्ण, इतनी सी बात के लिए तुम ने चंदन का कलात्मक लकडी का पलंग क्यों तोड डाला ?” इसपर कर्ण बोला, ‘‘ये वस्तुएं पुनः बनाई जा सकती हैं; परंतु जब किसी को कुछ देने का समय आए और हम वह क्षण गंवा दें, इसके समान दु:ख कौन-सा होगा ?”

आगे इसी कर्ण ने अपनी वरदान में मिले अंग के कवचकुंडल भी दान कर त्याग का अनुपम उदाहरण इतिहास में प्रस्तुत किया ।

 बालमित्रों, दानवीर कर्ण की कथा हमने देखी । हमें अपनी छोटी-सी वस्तु भी देने की इच्छा नहीं होती । जबकि कर्ण ने तो वरदान में मिले अंग के कवच-कुंडल भी दान कर दिए । हमें भी अपनी वस्तुओं का त्याग करना आना चाहिए ।
stories.title: दानवीर कर्ण
stories.content_english:
Balmitras, Karna was a close friend of Duryodhana. He was famous as a great philanthropist. He was famous for never turning away any beggar who came to him empty handed. He used to go to the river every morning to take bath. After getting into the water, he would offer water to the Sun and after bathing, he would provide anything to any beggar who came to him.

Once Lord Shri Krishna and Arjun were sitting and talking. The topic of Karna's bravery and charity came up during our conversation. Shri Krishna praised Karna's generosity. Shri Krishna said, “There is no other person as generous as Karna.” Arjun was a little surprised at this. Arjun said, “Shri Krishna, Dharamraj are also charitable.” Then who is the most charitable? Their discussion started on this. Shri Krishna said, “Okay, tomorrow we will go to both Dharamraj and Karna and test it.”

Those were rainy days . Next day, as soon as the sun rose, Shri Krishna and Arjun went to Dharmaraj. Dharamraj was very happy to see him. He welcomed both of them appropriately and then asked the reason for their coming there. Then Shri Krishna said, “Suddenly an important construction work has to be done in the capital. Wood is needed for that.” Dharamraj called his servants and ordered them to bring the best kind of wood for the construction work. There were various things here and there. A lot of time passed, but the servants did not return. After some time the servants returned with their heads bowed. Dharamraj said, “What happened?” Didn't get any wood?" The servants replied, “All the wood had become wet due to the rain, that is why we could not bring the wood.” Defeated, Dharamraj told Arjun and Shri Krishna the reason for not getting the wood. Shri Krishna and Arjun returned.

After that he went to Karna. Karna respectfully asked him to take his seat and inquired about his well-being. On this Arjun told about the sudden need of wood. Karna said, “If that is not all, then what is there to be so worried about?” Saying this he sent his servants to bring wood. After some time the servant returned and said, “The wood has become wet in the rain.” That's why we did not meet.'' As soon as Karna heard the words of the servants, he went inside and even after a long time, when he did not come out, Arjun started looking at Shri Krishna. Shri Krishna took him along and went to Karna's hall. Then what did you see, Karna was cutting the legs of his bed and he had also broken other wooden items nearby. Then it came to his mind why Karna was taking so much time. Arjun asked, “Karna, why did you break the artistic sandalwood bed for such a simple thing?” On this Karna said, “These things can be made again; But when the time comes to give something to someone and we miss that moment, what sorrow can be greater than this?”

Later, the same Karna also presented a unique example of sacrifice in history by donating the armor-rings of the body he had received as a boon.

 Friends, we have seen the story of the charitable Karna. We do not feel like giving away even our smallest things. Whereas Karna even donated the armor and earrings of the body he received as a boon. We should also know how to give up our things.
stories.content_hinglish:
balmitron, karn duryodhan ka ghanishth mitra tha . wah ek mahan daani ke roop mein prasiddh tha . wah apne paas aaye kisi bhi yachak ko kabhi khali haath nahin lautata tha, aisi uski kirti thi . wah pratidin subah snan ke liye nadipar jata tha . jal mein utarkar surya ko argh deta aur snan ke uprant jo bhi yachak uske paas aata, use wah munhmangi vastu pradan karta tha .

ek baar bhagwan shrikrishna tatha arjun baithe vartalap kar rahe the . baaton- baaton mein karn ki daan veerta ka vishay aa gaya . shrikrishnaji ne karn ki danvirta ki prashansa ki . shrikrishna bole, ‘‘karn jitna udaar vyakti anya koi nahin hai .’’ ispar arjun ko thoda aashcharya hua . arjun bola, ‘‘shrikrishna, dharmraj bhi daanveer hain .” tab sarvadhik daanveer kaun hai ? ispar unki charcha aarambh ho gai . shrikrishna bole, ‘‘thik hai, kal hi hum dharmraj aur karn donon ke paas ja kar iski pariksha lenge .”

varsha ke din the . agle din suraj nikalte hi shrikrishna tatha arjun dharmraj ke paas gaye . unhen dekhkar dharmraj ko atyant anand hua . unhone un donon ka yathochit swagat kiya aur phir unke vahan aane ka karan pucha . tab shrikrishna bole, ‘‘rajdhani mein achanak ek mahatvapurn nirman karya karna hai . uske liye lakdiyan chahiye .” dharmraj ne apne sevakon ko bulaya tatha nirman karya ke liye uttam prakar ki lakdiyan laane ki aagya di . idhar-udhar ki baatein huin . bahut samay nikal gaya, kintu sevak wapas nahin laute . kuch samay ke uprant sevak apna sir jhukae laute . dharmraj bole, ‘‘kya hua ? lakdiyan nahin milin ?” sevakon ne uttar diya, ‘‘varsha ke karan sari lakdiyan bheeg chuki thin, is karan hum lakdiyan nahin la sake hain .’’ haar kar dharmraj ne arjun tatha shrikrishna ko lakdiyan na milne ka karan bataya . shrikrishna tatha arjun laut gaye .

taduprant ve karn ke paas gaye . karn ne unhen aadarpurvak aasan grahan karne ko kaha aur unka kushalkshem pucha . ispar arjun ne lakdiyon ki achanak aavashyakta aan padane ke baare mein bataya . karn bola, ‘‘itna hi ne, to isme itni chinta karne ki kya baat hai ?” aisa kaha kar usne apne sevakon ko lakdiyan laane bheja . kuch samay mein wah sevak laut aaya aur bola, ‘‘barish mein lakdiyan bheeg chuki hain . isliye nahin milin .’’ sevakon ki baat sunte hi karn andar gaya aur bahut samay hone ke uprant bhi jab wah bahar nahin aaya to arjun shrikrishna ki aur dekhne laga . shrikrishna use saath lekar karn ke dalan mein gaya . tab dekhta kya hai, karn apne palang ke paaye kaat raha tha aur usne aaspaas bhi lakdi ka anya saman todkar rakha hai . tab unke dhyan me aaya ki karn ko itna samay kyon lag raha hai . arjun ne puchha, ‘‘karn, itni si baat ke liye tum ne chandan ka kalatmak lakdi ka palang kyon tod dala ?” ispar karn bola, ‘‘ye vastuen punah banai ja sakti han; parantu jab kisi ko kuch dene ka samay aaye aur hum wah kshan ganva den, iske samaan du:kh kaun-sa hoga ?”

aage isi karn ne apni vardaan mein mile ang ke kavchkundal bhi daan kar tyaag ka anupam udaharan itihaas mein prastut kiya .

 balmitron, daanveer karn ki katha humne dekhi . hamen apni chhoti-si vastu bhi dene ki ichchha nahin hoti . jabki karn ne to vardaan mein mile ang ke kavch-kundal bhi daan kar diye . hamen bhi apni vastuon ka tyaag karna aana chahiye .

stories.content:
अनेक वर्ष पूर्व की कहानी है । एक राजा था, जिसका नाम रामधन था । उसके राज्‍य का कामकाज आराम से चल रहा था ।

राजा के नैतिक गुणों के कारण प्रजा भी प्रसन्‍न थी । जिस राज्‍य में प्रजा संतुष्‍ट होती है, वह राज्‍य प्रत्‍येक क्षेत्र में आगे होता है ।

राजा के जीवन में सभी सुख थे परन्‍तु सारे सुख होने के बाद भी राजा दुःखी था, क्‍योंकि राजा की कोई संतान नहीं थी । प्रजा को भी इस बात का दुःख था । कुछ वर्षों के बाद राजा को एक पुत्र हुआ । पुरे नगर में कई दिनों तक आनंद उत्‍सव मना । नागरिकों के लिए राजमहल में भव्‍य भोज का आयोजन हुआ । राजा के आनंद में प्रजा भी आनंदित थी ।

राजा ने राजकुमार का नाम नंदनसिंह रखा । उसे बडेे लाड प्‍यार से रखा जाता । अत्‍यधिक लाड-प्‍यार ने नंदनसिंह को बिगाड दिया था । वह अत्‍यंत जिद्दी हो गया था । उसके मन में अहंकार था । वह चाहता था कि प्रजा सदैव उसकी जयजयकार करे और उसकी प्रशंसा करें । यदि कोई उसकी बात नहीं सुनता तो वह कोलाहल मचा देता था । वह स्‍वयं को भगवान ही समझता था ।

नंदन के इस व्‍यवहार से सभी अत्‍यंत दुःखी थे । राजा के दरबार में प्रजाजन नंदन की शिकायत लेकर आते, जिसके कारण राजा का सिर लज्‍जा से झुक जाता था । एक दिन राजा ने विशेष मंत्रियों की सभा बुलाई । राजा ने कहा कि वह राजकुमार के व्‍यवहार से अत्‍यंत दुःखी है । राजकुमार इस राज्‍य का भविष्‍य है, यदि उनका व्‍यवहार ऐसा ही रहा तो राज्‍य की खुशहाली कुछ दिनों में ही चली जाएगी । मंत्रियों ने राजा को हिम्‍मत रखने के लिए कहा । एक मंत्री ने सुझाव दिया कि राजकुमार को योग्‍य मार्गदर्शन और सामान्‍य जीवन का अनुभव होना आवश्‍यक है । आप उन्‍हें गुरु राधागुप्‍त के आश्रम भेज दीजिए । गुरु राधागुप्‍त अत्‍यंत योग्‍य और आवश्‍यक शिक्षा देते है । राजा को यह सुझाव अच्‍छा लगा । अगले दिन राजा अपने पुत्र के साथ गुरु राधागुप्‍त जी के आश्रम पहुंचे । राजा ने उन्‍हें राजकुमार नंदन के विषय में सारी बातें बताई । गुरुदेव जी ने राजा को आश्‍वस्‍त किया कि जब वे शिक्षा पूरी होनेपर अपने पुत्र से मिलेंगे तब उन्‍हें अपने पुत्र पर अभिमान होगा । गुरुजी के ऐसे शब्‍द सुनकर राजा संतुष्‍ट हुए और अपने पुत्र को आश्रम में छोडकर राजमहल लौट गये ।

अगली सुबह गुरुदेव जी ने अपने एक शिष्‍य को एक संदेश देकर नंदन के पास भेजा । शिष्‍य ने नंदन को बताया कि स्‍वयं के भोजन के लिए भिक्षा मांगकर लानी है । यह सुनकर नंदन ने उसे मना कर दिया । शिष्‍य ने उससे कहा कि यदि पेट भरना है, तो भिक्षा मांगनी होगी और भिक्षा भी केवल शाम तक ही मांगनी है, अन्‍यथा भूखा रहना पडेगा । नंदन ने अपनी अकड में उसकी बात नहीं मानी । शाम होते होते नंदन को भूख लगने लगी; परन्‍तु भिक्षा न लाने के कारण वह भोजन नहीं कर पाया ।

भूख मिटाने की आवश्‍यकता जानकर दुसरे दिन से उसने भिक्षा मांगना आरंभ किया । पहले पहले उसके अयोग्‍य बोल के कारण उसे कोई भिक्षा नहीं देता था, परन्‍तु गुरुकुल में सभी के साथ बैठने पर उसे आधा पेट भोजन मिल जाता था । धीरे धीरे उसे सभी से अच्‍छे से बात करने का, मीठे बोल बोलने का महत्‍व समझ में आने लगा । एक माह के बाद नंदन को भरपेट भोजन मिला, जिसके बाद उसके व्‍यवहार में बहुत सारे परिवर्तन आए । इसी प्रकार गुरुकुल के एक-एक नियम के अनुसार आचरण करने के कारण राजकुमार नंदन में अच्‍छा परिवर्तन होने लगा । राजकुमार में हो रहे ये परिवर्तन गुरु राधागुप्‍त ध्‍यान से देख रहे थे ।

एक दिन सवेरे गुरु राधागुप्‍तजी ने नंदन को अपने साथ सैर पर चलने के लिए कहा । दोनों सैर पर निकल गए । मार्ग मे उन्‍होंने अनेक विषयों पर चर्चा की । गुरुजी ने नंदन से कहा, ‘‘नंदन तुम बुद्धिमान हो और तुममें अधिक उर्जा है, जिसका तुम्‍हें उचित दिशा मे उपयोग करना चाहिए । दोनों चलते-चलते एक सुंदर बाग में पहुंचे । बाग में अनेक सुंदर-सुंदर फूल खिले थे, जिनसे बाग महक रहा था । गुरुजी ने नंदन से कहा कि पूजा के लिए गुलाब के फुल तोडकर लाए । नंदन ने झट से सुंदर सुंदर गुलाब तोडकर लाए और अपने गुरुदेवजी के सामने रख दिए । अब गुरुदेवजी ने उसे नीम के पत्ते तोडकर लाने के लिए कहा । नंदन वह भी ले आया । उसके बाद गुरुदेवजी ने उसे एक गुलाब सुंघने को कहा और पूछा, ‘‘तुम्‍हें कैसे लगा ?’’ नंदन ने गुलाब को सुंघकर उसकी प्रशंसा की । बाद में गुरुजी ने उसे नीम के पत्ते चखकर उसके बारे में पूछा । जैसे ही नंदन ने नीम के पत्ते खाए उसका मुंह कडवा हो गया और उसने नीम के पत्तों की निंदा की और पीने का पानी ढूंढने लगा ।

नंदन की ऐसी स्‍थिती देखकर गुरुदेवजी हसें । पानी पीने के बाद नंदन शांत हुआ । उसने गुरुदेवजी से हंसने का कारण पूछा ।

तब वे बोले, ‘‘बेटा नंदन, जब तुमने गुलाब का फुल सुंघा तो तुम्‍हें अच्‍छा लगा और तुमने उसकी प्रशंसा की, परन्‍तु जब नीम की पत्तियां खाईं, तो वह कडवी होने के कारण तुमने उसकी निंदा की । गुरुदेवजी ने नंदन को समझाया कि जिस प्रकार तुम्‍हें जो अच्‍छा लगता हैं, तुम उसकी प्रशंसा करते हो । उसी प्रकार प्रजा भी जिसमें गुण होते है, उसी की प्रशंसा करती है । यदि तुम उनके साथ अयोग्‍य व्‍यवहार करोगे और उनसे प्रशंसा की आशा करोगे, तो वे तुम्‍हारी प्रशंसा मन से नही कर पाएंगे । जहां गुण होते है, वहां प्रशंसा होती है ।’’

अब राजकुमार नंदन को पूरी बात विस्‍तार से समझ आई और वह शिक्षा लेकर अपने महल लौट गया । नंदन में अच्‍छा परिवर्तन होने के कारण उसमें गुण बढ गए और वह एक यशस्‍वी राजा बन गया । गुरुदेवजी की सीख के अनुसार आचरण करने के कारण नंदन का जीवन ही बदल दिया । वह एक क्रूर राजकुमार से एक न्‍यायप्रिय, दयालु राजा बन गया ।
stories.title: गुणों का महत्‍व
stories.content_english:
The story is from many years ago. There was a king, whose name was Ramdhan. The work of his kingdom was going on smoothly.

The people were also happy because of the moral qualities of the king. The state in which the people are satisfied is ahead in every field.

There were all the happiness in the king's life, but despite all the happiness, the king was sad because the king had no children. The people were also sad about this. After a few years the king had a son. Anand Utsav was celebrated in the entire city for several days. A grand banquet was organized for the citizens in the palace. The people were also happy with the happiness of the king.

The king named the prince Nandan Singh. He was kept with great pampering. Excessive pampering had spoiled Nandan Singh. He had become extremely stubborn. He had ego in his mind. He wanted the people to always cheer and praise him. If anyone did not listen to him, he would create an uproar. He considered himself God.

Everyone was very saddened by this behavior of Nandan. People would come to the king's court with complaints about Nandan, due to which the king would bow his head in shame. One day the king called a meeting of special ministers. The king said that he was extremely saddened by the prince's behaviour. The prince is the future of this state, if his behavior continues like this then the prosperity of the state will go away within a few days. The ministers asked the king to have courage. A minister suggested that the prince needed competent guidance and experience of normal life. You send him to Guru Radhagupta's ashram. Guru Radha Gupta gives very useful and necessary teachings. The king liked this suggestion. The next day the king reached the ashram of Guru Radhagupta ji with his son. The king told him everything about Prince Nandan. Gurudev ji assured the king that he would be proud of his son when he met him after completing his education. Hearing such words of Guruji, the king was satisfied and returned to the palace leaving his son in the ashram.

Next morning Gurudev ji sent one of his disciples to Nandan with a message. The disciple told Nandan that he had to beg for his own food. Hearing this, Nandan refused him. The disciple told him that if he wanted to fill his stomach, he would have to beg for alms and that too only till the evening, otherwise he would have to remain hungry. Nandan, in his arrogance, did not listen to him. By evening Nandan started feeling hungry; But because he did not bring alms he could not eat.

Knowing the need to satisfy his hunger, he started begging from the next day. Earlier no one gave him alms because of his unworthy speech, but when he sat with everyone in the Gurukul, he used to get half his full meal. Gradually he started understanding the importance of talking nicely to everyone and speaking sweet words. After a month, Nandan got full food, after which many changes took place in his behaviour. Similarly, due to behaving according to each and every rule of Gurukul, good changes started taking place in Prince Nandan. Guru Radha Gupta was carefully watching the changes taking place in the prince.

One morning Guru Radha Guptaji asked Nandan to go for a walk with him. Both of them went out for a walk. They discussed many topics on the way. Guruji said to Nandan, “Nandan, you are intelligent and you have more energy, which you should use in the right direction. While walking, both of them reached a beautiful garden. Many beautiful flowers were blooming in the garden, due to which the garden was smelling fragrant. Guruji asked Nandan to pluck rose flowers and bring them for puja. Nandan quickly plucked beautiful roses and placed them in front of his Gurudevji. Now Gurudevji asked him to pluck neem leaves and bring them. Nandan brought that also. After that Gurudevji asked him to smell a rose and asked, “How did you like it?” Nandan smelled the rose and praised it. Later Guruji made him taste the neem leaves and asked him about it. As soon as Nandan ate the neem leaves, his mouth became bitter and he condemned the neem leaves and started searching for drinking water.

Seeing Nandan in such a condition, Gurudevji laughed. Nandan calmed down after drinking water. He asked Gurudevji the reason for laughing.

Then he said, “Son Nandan, when you smelled the rose flower, you liked it and praised it, but when you ate the neem leaves, you criticized them because they were bitter. Gurudevji explained to Nandan that you praise whatever you like. Similarly, people also praise the one who has good qualities. If you behave unworthy of them and expect praise from them, they will not be able to praise you wholeheartedly. Where there are qualities, there is praise.”

Now Prince Nandan understood the whole thing in detail and he returned to his palace after taking education. Due to good changes in Nandan, his qualities increased and he became a famous king. Nandan's life changed by behaving as per the teachings of Gurudevji. He changed from a cruel prince to a just, merciful king.
stories.content_hinglish:
anek varsh purva ki kahani hai . ek raja tha, jiska naam ramdhan tha . uske rajya ka kaamkaaj aaram se chal raha tha .

raja ke naitik gunon ke karan praja bhi prasann thi . jis rajya mein praja santusht hoti hai, wah rajya pratyek kshetra mein aage hota hai .

raja ke jeevan mein sabhi sukh the parantu sare sukh hone ke baad bhi raja dukhi tha, kyonki raja ki koi santan nahin thi . praja ko bhi is baat ka dukh tha . kuch varshon ke baad raja ko ek putra hua . pure nagar mein kai dinon tak anand utsav mana . nagrikon ke liye rajmahal mein bhavya bhoj ka aayojan hua . raja ke anand mein praja bhi anandit thi .

raja ne rajkumar ka naam nandansingh rakha . use badeay lad pyar se rakha jata . atyadhik lad-pe‍yar ne nandansingh ko bigad diya tha . wah atyant jiddi ho gaya tha . uske man mein ahankaar tha . wah chahta tha ki praja sadaiv uski jayjaykar kare aur uski prashansa karen . yadi koi uski baat nahin sunta to wah kolahal macha deta tha . wah swayam ko bhagwan hi samajhta tha .

nandan ke is vyavahar se sabhi atyant dukhi the . raja ke darbar mein prajajan nandan ki shikayat lekar aate, jiske karan raja ka sir laj‍ja se jhuk jata tha . ek din raja ne vishesh mantriyon ki sabha bulai . raja ne kaha ki wah rajkumar ke vyavahar se atyant dukhi hai . rajkumar is rajya ka bhavishya hai, yadi unka vyavahar aisa hi raha to rajya ki khushhali kuch dinon mein hi chali jayegi . mantriyon ne raja ko himmat rakhne ke liye kaha . ek mantri ne sujhaav diya ki rajkumar ko yogya margdarshan aur samanya jeevan ka anubhav hona aavashyak hai . aap unhen guru radhagupe‍ta ke aashram bhej dijiye . guru radhagupe‍ta atyant yogya aur aavashyak shiksha dete hai . raja ko yah sujhaav acha laga . agle din raja apne putra ke saath guru radhagupe‍ta ji ke aashram pahunche . raja ne unhen rajkumar nandan ke vishay mein sari baatein batai . gurudev ji ne raja ko aash‍vas‍ta kiya ki jab ve shiksha puri honepar apne putra se milenge tab unhen apne putra par abhimaan hoga . guruji ke aise shabd sunkar raja santusht hue aur apne putra ko aashram mein chodkar rajmahal laut gaye .

agli subah gurudev ji ne apne ek shish‍ya ko ek sandesh dekar nandan ke paas bheja . shish‍ya ne nandan ko bataya ki swayam ke bhojan ke liye bhiksha mangkar lani hai . yah sunkar nandan ne use mana kar diya . shish‍ya ne usse kaha ki yadi pet bharna hai, to bhiksha mangni hogi aur bhiksha bhi keval sham tak hi mangni hai, anyatha bhukha rehna padegaa . nandan ne apni akd mein uski baat nahin mani . sham hote hote nandan ko bhookh lagne lagi; parantu bhiksha na laane ke karan wah bhojan nahin kar paya .

bhukh mitane ki aavashyakta jaankar dusre din se usne bhiksha mangna aarambh kiya . pehle pehle uske ayogya bol ke karan use koi bhiksha nahin deta tha, parantu gurukul mein sabhi ke saath baithne par use aadha pet bhojan mil jata tha . dheere dheere use sabhi se acche se baat karne ka, meethe bol bolne ka mahatva samajh mein aane laga . ek mah ke baad nandan ko bharpet bhojan mila, jiske baad uske vyavahar mein bahut sare parivartan aaye . isi prakar gurukul ke ek-ek niyam ke anusar aacharan karne ke karan rajkumar nandan mein acha parivartan hone laga . rajkumar mein ho rahe yeh parivartan guru radhagupe‍ta dhyan se dekh rahe the .

ek din savere guru radhagupe‍taji ne nandan ko apne saath sair par chalne ke liye kaha . donon sair par nikal gaye . marg me unhone anek vishayon par charcha ki . guruji ne nandan se kaha, ‘‘nandan tum buddhiman ho aur tummein adhik urja hai, jiska tumhe uchit disha me upyog karna chahiye . donon chalte-chalte ek sundar baag mein pahunche . baag mein anek sunder-sunder phool khile the, jinse baag mahak raha tha . guruji ne nandan se kaha ki pooja ke liye gulab ke full todkar lae . nandan ne jhat se sundar sundar gulab todkar lae aur apne gurudevji ke samne rakh diye . ab gurudevji ne use neem ke patte todkar laane ke liye kaha . nandan wah bhi le aaya . uske baad gurudevji ne use ek gulab sunghne ko kaha aur puchha, ‘‘tum‍hen kaise laga ?’’ nandan ne gulab ko sunghakar uski prashansa ki . baad mein guruji ne use neem ke patte chakhkar uske baare mein pucha . jaise hi nandan ne neem ke patte khae uska munh kadava ho gaya aur usne neem ke patton ki ninda ki aur peene ka pani dhundhne laga .

nandan ki aisi s‍thiti dekhkar gurudevji hasen . pani peene ke baad nandan shant hua . usne gurudevji se hansne ka karan pucha .

tab ve bole, ‘‘beta nandan, jab tumne gulab ka full sungha to tumhe acha laga aur tumne uski prashansa ki, parantu jab neem ki pattiyan khain, to wah kadavi hone ke karan tumne uski ninda ki . gurudevji ne nandan ko samjhaya ki jis prakar tumhe jo acha lagta han, tum uski prashansa karte ho . usi prakar praja bhi jisme gun hote hai, usi ki prashansa karti hai . yadi tum unke saath ayogya vyavahar karoge aur unse prashansa ki aasha karoge, to ve tumhari prashansa man se nahi kar payenge . jahan gun hote hai, vahan prashansa hoti hai .’’

ab rajkumar nandan ko puri baat vistar se samajh aai aur wah shiksha lekar apne mahal laut gaya . nandan mein acha parivartan hone ke karan usme gun badh gaye aur wah ek yashas‍vi raja ban gaya . gurudevji ki seekh ke anusar aacharan karne ke karan nandan ka jeevan hi badal diya . wah ek krur rajkumar se ek n‍yayapriya, dayalu raja ban gaya .

सीता माता को छुडाने के लिए हनुमानजी ने रावण की लंका का दहन किया था, आज हम उसकी कथा सुनेंगे ।

हनुमानजी माता सीता से लंका में अशोकवाटीका में छोटा रूप धारण कर मिले तथा सीता माता की आज्ञा से अपनी भूख मिटाने के लिए वाटिका से फल तोडकर खाने लगे । तब वहां पर पहरा दे रहे राक्षसों ने हनुमानजी को देखा और उन्‍हें साधारण वानर समझकर उन्‍हें मारने के लिए दौड पडे; परंतु हनुमानजी ने अपनी शक्‍ति का प्रयोग कर राक्षसों पर आक्रमण किया । कुछ राक्षस अपने प्राण बचाकर रावण के समक्ष पहुंचे तथा उन्‍होंने रावण को समाचार दिया कि एक वानर ने अशोकवाटिका को उजाड दिया है तथा बहुत से राक्षसों को भी मार दिया है । रावण यह समाचार सुनकर बहुत क्रोधित हुआ, तब रावण के पुत्र इंद्रजीत ने हनुमानजी को पकडकर लाने के लिए रावण से आज्ञा ली तथा हनुमानजी पर ब्रह्मास्‍त्र से वार कर उन्‍हें बंदी बना लिया तथा सभा में ले गए । हनुमानजी रावण के सामने खडे विचार कर रहे थे । समस्‍त लोकों को डरानेवाला महाबाहु रावण हनुमानजी को सामने इस प्रकार निर्भय खडा देखकर क्रोधीत हो गया । वह अपने महामन्‍त्री से बोला, ‘‘अमात्‍य ! इससे पूछो कि यह कहां से आया है ? इसे किसने भेजा है ? सीता से यह क्‍यों बाते कर रहा था ? अशोकवाटिका को इसने क्‍यों नष्‍ट किया ? इसने किस उद्देश्‍य से राक्षसों को मारा ? मेरी इस लंकापुरी में आनेका प्रयोजन क्‍या है ? ’’

रावण की आज्ञा पाकर मंत्री ने हनुमानजी से लंका में आने का कारण पूछा । तब हनुमानजी ने उत्तर दिया कि ‘‘मैं श्री रामचन्‍द्र जी का दूत हूं और उनके ही कार्य से यहां आया हूं ।’’

हनुमानजी ने कुछ क्षण शान्‍तभाव से सभी की ओर देखा और आगे कहा, ‘‘मैं किष्‍किन्‍धा के परम पराक्रमी राजा सुग्रीव का दूत हूं । उन्‍हीं की आज्ञा से तुम्‍हारे पास आया हूं । हमारे महाराज ने तुम्‍हारा कुशल समाचार पूछा है और कहा है कि तुमने नीतिवान, धर्म, चारों वेदों के ज्ञाता, महापण्‍डीत, तपस्‍वी और महान ऐश्‍वर्यवान होते हुए भी एक परस्‍त्री को अपने यहां बंदी बनाया है, यह तुम्‍हारे लिए उचित बात नहीं है । तुमने यह दुष्‍कर्म करके अपनी मृत्‍यु का आव्‍हान किया है । तुम सीता माता को प्रभु श्रीरामचंद्रजी को लौटा दो । वे निश्‍चित ही तुम्‍हें क्षमा कर देंगे । यदि तुम ऐसा नही करोगे, तो तुम्‍हारा अन्‍त भी वही होगा जो खर, दूषण और बालि का हुआ था ।

हनुमानजी की यह बात सुनकर रावण क्रोधित हो उठा । उसने अपने सेवकों को आज्ञा दी, ‘इस वानर का वध कर डालो ।’ रावण की आज्ञा सुनकर वहां उपस्‍थित विभीषण ने कहा, ‘‘राक्षसराज ! आप धर्म के ज्ञाता और राजधर्म के विशेषज्ञ हैं । दूत के वध से आपके पाण्‍डित्‍य पर कलंक लग जाएगा । इसलिए उचित-अनुचित का विचार करें और दूत के योग्‍य किसी अन्‍य दण्‍ड की आज्ञा दें ।’’ रावण ने कहा, ‘‘शत्रुसूदन ! पापियों का वध करने में पाप नहीं है । इस वानर ने वाटिका का विध्‍वंस तथा राक्षसों का वध करके पाप किया है । इसलिए मैं इसका वध करूंगा ।’’

रावण की यह बात सुनकर उसके भाई विभीषण ने नम्रता के स्‍वर में कहा, ‘‘हे लंकापति ! जब यह वानर स्‍वयं को दूत बताता है, तो नीति तथा धर्म के अनुसार इसका वध करना अनुचित होगा । क्‍योंकि दूत दूसरों का दिया हुआ सन्‍देश सुनाता है । वह जो कुछ कहता है, वह उसकी अपनी बात नहीं होती, इसलिए उसका वध नही किया जा सकता ।’’

विभीषण की बात पर विचार करने के बाद रावण ने कहां, ‘‘तुम्‍हारा यह कथन सत्‍य है कि दूत का वध नहीं किया जा सकता । परन्‍तु इसने अशोकवाटिका का विध्‍वंस किया है । इसका दण्‍ड तो इसे मिलना चाहिए । वानरों को अपनी पूंछ प्रिय होती है । इसलिए मैं आज्ञा देता हूं कि, इसकी पूंछ रुई और तेल लगाकर जला दी जाए । ताकि इसे बिना पूंछ का देखकर लोग इसकी हंसी उडाए और यह जीवन भर अपने कर्मों पर पछताएं ।’’

रावण की आज्ञा से राक्षसों ने हनुमान की पूंछ को रुई और पुराने कपडो से लपेटकर उस पर बहुत सा तेल डालकर आग लगा दी । जैसे जैसे राक्षस हनुमानजी की पूंछ पर कपडे लपेट रहे थे, वैसे वैसे हनुमानजी भी अपनी पूंछ बढाते जा रहे थे । अंत में उनकी पूंछ को आग लगा दी गई । पूंछ के जलते ही हनुमानजी ने अपने सारे बंधन तोडकर ऊंची छलांग लगाई और रावण की सोने की लंका जला दी ।

सम्‍पूर्ण लंकापुरी में केवल एक भवन ऐसा था जो अग्‍नि के प्रकोप से सुरक्षित था और वह था नीतिवान विभीषण का प्रासाद ।

लंका को भस्‍म कर हनुमानजी ने लंका के समुद्र में अपनी पूंछ की आग बुझाई और पुनः अशोकवाटिका में सीता के पास पहुंचे ।

उन्‍हें सादर प्रणाम करके बोले, ‘‘हे माता ! अब मैं यहाँ से श्री रामचन्‍द्र जी के पास लौट रहा हूं । रावण को और लंकावासिययों को मैंने प्रभु राघव शक्‍ति का थोडा सा आभास करा दिया है । अब आप निर्भय होकर रहें । अब शीघ्र ही प्रभु श्री रामचन्‍द्र जी वानर सेना के साथ लंका पर आक्रमण करेंगे और रावण को मार कर आपको अपने साथ ले जाएंगे । विशाल सागर को पार करते हुए हनुमान वापस सागर के उस तट पर पहुंचे जहां प्रभु श्रीरामजी थे । हनुमान ने वहां पहुंच कर सबका अभिवादन किया और लंका का समाचार सुनाया । सभी वानर प्रभु श्रीरामजी तथा पवनसुत की जयजयकार करने लगे ।
stories.title: लंकादहन !
stories.content_english:
To free Mother Sita, Hanumanji had burnt Ravana's Lanka, today we will listen to his story.

Hanumanji met Mother Sita in a small form in Ashoka garden in Lanka and with the permission of Mother Sita, he started plucking fruits from the garden and eating them to satisfy his hunger. Then the demons guarding there saw Hanumanji and considering him to be an ordinary monkey, they rushed to kill him; But Hanumanji used his power and attacked the demons. Some demons saved their lives and came before Ravana and informed Ravana that a monkey had destroyed Ashokavatika and had also killed many demons. Ravana became very angry after hearing this news, then Ravana's son Indrajit took permission from Ravana to arrest Hanumanji and attacked him with Brahmastra and took him captive and took him to the court. Hanumanji was standing in front of Ravana and thinking. The mighty Ravana, who terrorized all the worlds, became angry after seeing Hanumanji standing fearless in front of him. He said to his Prime Minister, “Amatya! Ask him where it came from? Who has sent this? Why was he talking to Sita? Why did he destroy Ashokavatika? For what purpose did he kill the demons? What is the purpose of my coming to Lankapuri? ''

After getting Ravana's permission, the minister asked Hanumanji the reason for coming to Lanka. Then Hanumanji replied, “I am the messenger of Shri Ramchandra ji and have come here on his own work.”

Hanumanji looked at everyone calmly for a few moments and further said, “I am the messenger of Sugriva, the most mighty king of Kishkindha. It is on his orders that I have come to you. Our king has asked about your well-being and has said that despite being a man of good conduct, religion, knowledge of the four Vedas, a great scholar, an ascetic and a person of great wealth, you have kept a foreign woman captive in your house, this is not appropriate for you. By committing this misdeed you have invited your death. You return Mother Sita to Lord Shri Ramchandraji. He will definitely forgive you. If you do not do this, your end will be the same as that of Khar, Dushan and Bali.

Ravana got angry after hearing these words of Hanumanji. He ordered his servants, 'Kill this monkey.' Hearing Ravana's order, Vibhishana present there said, "King of demons! You are an expert on religion and Rajdharma. Your scholarship will be tarnished by the killing of the messenger. Therefore, consider what is right and wrong and order some other punishment worthy of the messenger." Ravana said, "O enemy! There is no sin in killing sinners. This monkey has committed sin by destroying the garden and killing the demons. That's why I will kill him."

Hearing these words of Ravana, his brother Vibhishana said in a humble voice, “O Lord of Lanka! When this monkey calls himself a messenger, then according to policy and religion it would be inappropriate to kill it. Because the messenger conveys the message given by others. Whatever he says is not his own words, therefore he cannot be killed.”

After considering Vibhishana's words, Ravana said, "What you say is true that a messenger cannot be killed." But it has destroyed Ashokavatika. He should be punished for this. Monkeys love their tails. Therefore, I order that its tail be smeared with cotton and oil and burnt. So that seeing it without a tail, people will make fun of it and it will regret its actions throughout its life.

On the orders of Ravana, the demons wrapped Hanuman's tail with cotton and old clothes, poured a lot of oil on it and set it on fire. As the demons were wrapping clothes around Hanumanji's tail, Hanumanji was also growing his tail. Finally his tail was set on fire. As soon as the tail was lit, Hanumanji broke all his bonds, jumped high and burnt Ravana's golden Lanka.

There was only one building in the whole of Lankapuri which was safe from the wrath of fire and that was the palace of policyman Vibhishana.

After destroying Lanka, Hanumanji extinguished the fire of his tail in the sea of ​​Lanka and again reached Sita in Ashokavatika.

Saluting her respectfully, he said, “O Mother! Now I am returning from here to Shri Ramchandra ji. I have made Ravana and the people of Lanka realize a little about the power of Lord Raghav. Now you live without fear. Now soon Lord Shri Ramchandra ji will attack Lanka with his monkey army and will kill Ravana and take you with him. Crossing the vast ocean, Hanuman returned to the shore of the ocean where Lord Shri Ram was. Hanuman reached there and greeted everyone and told the news of Lanka. All the monkeys started praising Lord Shri Ram and Pavansut.
stories.content_hinglish:
sita mata ko chhudaane ke liye hanumanji ne ravan ki lanka ka dahan kiya tha, aaj hum uski katha sunenge .

hanumanji mata sita se lanka mein ashokwatika mein chhota roop dharan kar mile tatha sita mata ki aagya se apni bhookh mitane ke liye vatika se fal todkar khane lage . tab vahan par pehra de rahe rakshason ne hanumanji ko dekha aur unhen sadharan vanar samajhkar unhen maarne ke liye daud pade; parantu hanumanji ne apni shakti ka prayog kar rakshason par aakraman kiya . kuch rakshas apne pran bachakar ravan ke samaksh pahunche tatha unhone ravan ko samachar diya ki ek vanar ne ashokwatika ko ujad diya hai tatha bahut se rakshason ko bhi maar diya hai . ravan yah samachar sunkar bahut krodhit hua, tab ravan ke putra indrajeet ne hanumanji ko pakadkar laane ke liye ravan se aagya lee tatha hanumanji par brahmace‍tra se war kar unhen bandi bana liya tatha sabha mein le gaye . hanumanji ravan ke samne khade vichar kar rahe the . samast lokon ko daranewala mahabahu ravan hanumanji ko samne is prakar nirbhay khada dekhkar krodheet ho gaya . wah apne mahaman‍tri se bola, ‘‘amat‍ya ! isse poochho ki yah kahan se aaya hai ? ise kisne bheja hai ? sita se yah kyon baate kar raha tha ? ashokwatika ko isne kyon nasht kiya ? isne kis uddeshya se rakshason ko mara ? meri is lankapuri mein aaneka prayojan kya hai ? ’’

ravan ki aagya pakar mantri ne hanumanji se lanka mein aane ka karan pucha . tab hanumanji ne uttar diya ki ‘‘main shri ramchandra ji ka doot hun aur unke hi karya se yahan aaya hun .’’

hanumanji ne kuch kshan shan‍tabhav se sabhi ki or dekha aur aage kaha, ‘‘main kish‍kin‍dha ke param parakrami raja sugreev ka doot hun . unhin ki aagya se tumhare paas aaya hun . hamare maharaj ne tumhara kushal samachar pucha hai aur kaha hai ki tumne nitivan, dharm, charon vedon ke gyata, mahapan‍det, tapas‍vi aur mahan aish‍varyavan hote hue bhi ek paras‍tri ko apne yahan bandi banaya hai, yah tumhare liye uchit baat nahin hai . tumne yah dushkarm karke apni mrityu ka aave‍han kiya hai . tum sita mata ko prabhu shriramchandraji ko lauta do . ve nishchit hi tumhe kshama kar denge . yadi tum aisa nahi karoge, to tumhara ant bhi wahi hoga jo khar, dushan aur bali ka hua tha .

hanumanji ki yah baat sunkar ravan krodhit ho utha . usne apne sevakon ko aagya di, ‘is vanar ka vadh kar dalo .’ ravan ki aagya sunkar vahan ups‍thit vibhishan ne kaha, ‘‘rakshasraj ! aap dharm ke gyata aur rajdharm ke visheshagya hain . doot ke vadh se aapke pan‍dit‍ya par kalank lag jayega . isliye uchit-anuchit ka vichar karen aur doot ke yogya kisi anya dan‍d ki aagya den .’’ ravan ne kaha, ‘‘shatrusudan ! papiyon ka vadh karne mein paap nahin hai . is vanar ne vatika ka vidh‍vans tatha rakshason ka vadh karke paap kiya hai . isliye main iska vadh karunga .’’

ravan ki yah baat sunkar uske bhai vibhishan ne namrata ke swar mein kaha, ‘‘he lankapati ! jab yah vanar swayam ko doot batata hai, to niti tatha dharm ke anusar iska vadh karna anuchit hoga . kyonki doot dusron ka diya hua san‍desh sunata hai . wah jo kuch kehta hai, wah uski apni baat nahin hoti, isliye uska vadh nahi kiya ja sakta .’’

vibhishan ki baat par vichar karne ke baad ravan ne kahan, ‘‘tum‍hara yah kathan satya hai ki doot ka vadh nahin kiya ja sakta . parantu isne ashokwatika ka vidh‍vans kiya hai . iska dan‍d to ise milna chahiye . vanaron ko apni poonch priy hoti hai . isliye main aagya deta hun ki, iski poonch rui aur tel lagakar jala di jaye . taki ise bina poonch ka dekhkar log iski hansi udae aur yah jeevan bhar apne karmon par pachtaein .’’

ravan ki aagya se rakshason ne hanuman ki poonch ko rui aur purane kapdo se lapetkar us par bahut sa tel daalkar aag laga di . jaise jaise rakshas hanumanji ki poonch par kapde lapet rahe the, vaise vaise hanumanji bhi apni poonch badhate ja rahe the . ant mein unki poonch ko aag laga di gai . poonch ke jalte hi hanumanji ne apne sare bandhan todkar unchi chhalang lagai aur ravan ki sone ki lanka jala di .

sam‍purn lankapuri mein keval ek bhavan aisa tha jo ag‍ni ke prakop se surakshit tha aur wah tha nitivan vibhishan ka prasad .

lanka ko bhas‍m kar hanumanji ne lanka ke samudra mein apni poonch ki aag bujhai aur punah ashokwatika mein sita ke paas pahunche .

un‍hen sadar pranam karke bole, ‘‘he mata ! ab main yahan se shri ramchandra ji ke paas laut raha hun . ravan ko aur lankavasiyayon ko maine prabhu raghav shakti ka thoda sa aabhas kara diya hai . ab aap nirbhay hokar rahen . ab sheeghra hi prabhu shri ramchandra ji vanar sena ke saath lanka par aakraman karenge aur ravan ko maar kar aapko apne saath le jayenge . vishal sagar ko paar karte hue hanuman wapas sagar ke us tat par pahunche jahan prabhu shriramji the . hanuman ne vahan pahunch kar sabka abhivadan kiya aur lanka ka samachar sunaya . sabhi vanar prabhu shriramji tatha pawansut ki jayjaykar karne lage .

stories.content:
बालमित्रो, आइए आज हम अर्जुन तथा हनुमान जी का यह प्रसंग सुनते हैं । आनंद रामायण में वर्णन है कि अर्जुन के रथ पर हनुमान के विराजित होने के पीछे भी एक कारण है । एक बार रामेश्‍वरम् तीर्थ में अर्जुन का हनुमानजी से मिलन हो जाता है । इस पहली भेंट में हनुमानजी से अर्जुन ने कहा, ‘अरे राम और रावण के युद्घ के समय तो आप थे ?’

हनुमानजी ने कहा ‘हां’, तभी अर्जुन ने कहा, ‘आपके स्‍वामी श्रीराम तो बड़े ही श्रेष्ठ धनुर्धर थे तो फिर उन्‍हें समुद्र पार जाने के लिए पत्‍थरों का सेतु बनवाने की क्‍या आवश्‍यकता थी ? यदि मैं वहां उपस्‍थित होता तो समुद्र पर बाणों का सेतु बना देता जिस पर चढ़कर आपका पूरा वानर दल समुद्र पार कर लेता ।’ अर्जुन के इन वाक्‍यों में उनका अहंकार दिखाई दे रहा था ।

इस पर हनुमानजी ने कहा, ‘असंभव, बाणों का सेतु वहां पर कोई काम नहीं कर पाता । हमारा यदि एक भी वानर चढ़ता तो बाणों का सेतु छिन्‍न-भिन्‍न हो जाता।’ अर्जुन तो अहंकार के कारण कोई बात मानने को तैयार नहीं थे । उन्‍होंने कहा, ‘नहीं, देखो ये सामने सरोवर है, मैं उस पर बाणों का एक सेतु बनाता हूं । आप इस पर चढ़कर सरोवर को आसानी से पार कर लेंगे ।’

हनुमानजी ने कहा, ‘असंभव । तब अर्जुन ने कहा, ‘यदि आपके चलने से सेतु टूट जाएगा तो मैं अग्नि में प्रवेश कर जाऊंगा और यदि नहीं टूटता है तो आपको अग्नि में प्रवेश करना पडेगा ।’ हनुमानजी ने कहा, ‘मुझे स्‍वीकार है । मेरे दो चरण ही इसने झेल लिए तो मैं हार स्‍वीकार कर लूंगा ।’ अर्जुन इस मुद्दे पर अहंकार से चूर थे तथा हनुमान को सीधी चुनौती दे रहे थे । अर्जुन ने अपनी कलाकारी दिखानी प्रारंभ की । अर्जुन ने कुछ ही समय में अपने प्रचंड बाणों से सरोवर पर एक मजबूत सेतु बना दिया । जब तक सेतु बन रहा था, तब तक हनुमानजी का रूप लघु ही था; परंतु सेतु जैसे ही बन गया । हनुमानजी ने विराट रूप धारण कर लिया । हनुमान का विराट रूप अद्भुत था ।

अर्जुन बजरंग बली को हलके में ले रहे थे । यद्यपि अर्जुन धनुर्विद्या में निपुण थे, तब भी उनमें अहंकार था । अहंकार सदैव चूर- चूर हो जाता है । हनुमानजी, राम का स्‍मरण करते हुए उस बाणों के सेतु पर चढ़ गए । पहला पग रखते ही संपूर्ण सेतु डगमगाने लगा, दूसरा पैर रखते ही चरमराया और तीसरा पैर रखते ही सरोवर में गिर पडा ।

तभी श्रीहनुमानजी सेतु से नीचे उतर आए और अर्जुन से कहा कि अग्नि तैयार करो । अग्नि प्रज्‍वलित हुई और जैसे ही अर्जुन अग्नि में प्रवेश करनेवाले थे, वैसे भगवान श्रीकृष्‍ण प्रकट हो गए और बोले ठहरो ! तभी अर्जुन और हनुमानजी ने उन्‍हें प्रणाम किया ।

कृष्‍ण ने अर्जुन से पुनः पुल बनाने के लिए कहा और बोले अब प्रभु श्रीराम की शरण में जाकर तथा उनका नाम लेकर पुल बनाओ, अर्जुन ने भगवान श्रीकृष्‍णजी की आज्ञा का पालन किया । अब हनुमानजी को उस पुल पर चलने के लिए कहा ।

अपने सर्वश्रेष्ठ प्रयासों के बावजूद हनुमान पुल को तोड नहीं सके; इस समय हनुमानजी को भगवान कृष्‍ण में प्रभु श्रीराम का दर्शन हुआ । उस समय हनुमानजी ने वचन दिया कि महाभारत के युद्ध में वह अर्जुन के रथ के ध्‍वज पर विराजमान रहेंगे और युद्ध में अर्जुन की सहायता करने का वचन दिया । इस प्रकार हनुमानजी अर्जुन के रथ के ध्‍वज पर विराजमान रहे तथा उनकी युद्ध में रक्षा की । बालमित्रो, अब आप शरणागति का महत्त्व समझ ही गए होंगे । जब अर्जुन अहंकार त्‍यागकर शरणागत हुए, तब ही उस सरोवर पर सुदृढ पुल बना पाए ।

इसलिए अपने जीवन में कभी भी किसी बात का अहंकार नहीं करना चाहिए । सदैव भगवान के चरणों में शरणागत रहकर उन्‍हें पुकारना चाहिए, उनका नामजप करना चाहिए ।
stories.title: शरणागति का महत्त्व !
stories.content_english:
Children's friends, let us listen to this incident of Arjun and Hanuman ji today. It is described in Anand Ramayana that there is a reason behind Hanuman being seated on Arjun's chariot. Once Arjun meets Hanumanji at Rameshwaram Tirtha. In this first meeting, Arjun said to Hanumanji, 'Hey, you were there during the war between Ram and Ravana?'

Hanumanji said, 'Yes', then Arjun said, 'Your master Shri Ram was a very good archer, then what was the need for him to build a bridge of stones to cross the sea? If I had been present there, I would have made a bridge of arrows on the sea, on which your entire monkey group would have crossed the sea.' Arjun's arrogance was visible in these sentences.

On this Hanumanji said, 'Impossible, the bridge of arrows cannot do any work there. If even one of our monkeys had attacked, the bridge of arrows would have been broken.' Arjun was not ready to accept anything due to his ego. He said, 'No, look, there is a lake in front, I will make a bridge of arrows on it. You will cross the lake easily by climbing on it.

Hanumanji said, 'Impossible. Then Arjun said, 'If the bridge breaks due to your walking, I will enter the fire and if it does not break, you will have to enter the fire.' Hanumanji said, 'I accept. If he tolerates only two of my feet, I will accept defeat.' Arjun was full of ego on this issue and was giving a direct challenge to Hanuman. Arjun started showing his artistry. In no time, Arjun made a strong bridge over the lake with his fierce arrows. Till the time the bridge was being built, Hanumanji's form remained small; But as soon as the bridge was built. Hanumanji assumed a huge form. Hanuman's huge form was amazing.

Arjun was taking Bajrang Bali lightly. Even though Arjuna was skilled in archery, he still had ego. Ego always gets shattered. Hanumanji, remembering Ram, climbed onto the bridge of arrows. As soon as the first step was taken, the entire bridge began to waver, as soon as the second foot was taken, it creaked and as soon as the third foot was taken, it fell into the lake.

Then Shri Hanumanji came down from the bridge and asked Arjun to prepare the fire. The fire lit up and just as Arjun was about to enter the fire, Lord Krishna appeared and said wait! Then Arjun and Hanumanji saluted him.

Krishna again asked Arjun to build a bridge and said, now go to Lord Shri Ram and build a bridge by taking his name. Arjun followed the orders of Lord Shri Krishna. Now Hanumanji was asked to walk on that bridge.

Despite his best efforts Hanuman could not break the bridge; At this time Hanumanji saw Lord Shri Ram in Lord Krishna. At that time, Hanumanji promised that he would sit on the flag of Arjuna's chariot in the war of Mahabharata and promised to help Arjuna in the war. In this way Hanumanji remained seated on the flag of Arjun's chariot and protected him in the war. Children's friends, now you must have understood the importance of surrender. Only when Arjun gave up his ego and surrendered himself was he able to build a strong bridge over that lake.

Therefore, you should never be arrogant about anything in your life. One should always surrender at the feet of God and call him, chant his name.
stories.content_hinglish:
balmitro, aaie aaj hum arjun tatha hanuman ji ka yah prasang sunte hain . anand ramayan mein varnan hai ki arjun ke rath par hanuman ke virajit hone ke peeche bhi ek karan hai . ek baar ramesh‍varam tirth mein arjun ka hanumanji se milan ho jata hai . is pehli bhent mein hanumanji se arjun ne kaha, ‘are ram aur ravan ke yuddh ke samay to aap the ?’

hanumanji ne kaha ‘han’, tabhi arjun ne kaha, ‘aapke swami shriram to bade hi shreshth dhanurdhar the to phir unhen samudra paar jaane ke liye pat‍tharon ka setu banvane ki kya aavashyakta thi ? yadi main vahan ups‍thit hota to samudra par banon ka setu bana deta jis par chadhkar aapka pura vanar dal samudra paar kar leta .’ arjun ke in vak‍yon mein unka ahankaar dikhai de raha tha .

is par hanumanji ne kaha, ‘asambhav, banon ka setu vahan par koi kaam nahin kar pata . hamara yadi ek bhi vanar chadhta to banon ka setu chhin‍ne-bhin‍ne ho jata.’ arjun to ahankaar ke karan koi baat manne ko taiyar nahin the . unhone kaha, ‘nahin, dekho yeh samne sarovar hai, main us par banon ka ek setu banata hun . aap is par chadhkar sarovar ko aasani se paar kar lenge .’

hanumanji ne kaha, ‘asambhav . tab arjun ne kaha, ‘yadi aapke chalne se setu toot jayega to main agni mein pravesh kar jaunga aur yadi nahin tutata hai to aapko agni mein pravesh karna padegaa .’ hanumanji ne kaha, ‘mujhe sweekar hai . mere do charan hi isne jhel liye to main haar sweekar kar lunga .’ arjun is mudde par ahankaar se chur the tatha hanuman ko sidhi chunauti de rahe the . arjun ne apni kalakari dikhani prarambh ki . arjun ne kuch hi samay mein apne prachand banon se sarovar par ek majboot setu bana diya . jab tak setu ban raha tha, tab tak hanumanji ka roop laghu hi tha; parantu setu jaise hi ban gaya . hanumanji ne virat roop dharan kar liya . hanuman ka virat roop adbhut tha .

arjun bajrang bali ko halke mein le rahe the . yadyapi arjun dhanurvidya mein nipun the, tab bhi unme ahankaar tha . ahankaar sadaiv chur- chur ho jata hai . hanumanji, ram ka smaran karte hue us banon ke setu par chadh gaye . pehla pag rakhte hi sampurna setu dagmagane laga, dusra pair rakhte hi charmaraya aur teesra pair rakhte hi sarovar mein gir pada .

tabhi shrihanumanji setu se neeche utar aaye aur arjun se kaha ki agni taiyar karo . agni praj‍valit hui aur jaise hi arjun agni mein pravesh karnewale the, vaise bhagwan shrikrishna prakat ho gaye aur bole thahro ! tabhi arjun aur hanumanji ne unhen pranam kiya .

krish‍an ne arjun se punah pul banane ke liye kaha aur bole ab prabhu shriram ki sharan mein jaakar tatha unka naam lekar pul banao, arjun ne bhagwan shrikrish‍anji ki aagya ka palan kiya . ab hanumanji ko us pul par chalne ke liye kaha .
